KKR Joins Carlyle to Pour $475 Million Into Recording Rights Buyer Litmus Music

The company that owns hits by Katy Perry and Keith Urban will use the new capital to expand its holdings

By

Existing backer Carlyle Group and new investor KKR & Co. have bolstered Litmus Music with a fresh equity investment totaling roughly $475 million.

Litmus focuses on acquiring and managing music rights, including publishing and recorded music royalties. The company’s strategy encompasses multiple genres, with a portfolio that includes music and lyrics by performers Katy Perry, Keith Urban and Randy Newman.
